decisions.reason: The net price display plugin sits squarely within the firm's shop-extension expertise, so it can read early user feedback and maintain the plugin at low cost.
The ERP interface builds on the firm's integration know-how and serves recurring client needs, and its own development capacity lets it refine the plugin.
Price comparison tracking ties directly to the firm's analytics and marketplace knowledge, so it is easy to absorb and improve.
It is a close variant for another comparison portal and fits the firm's tracking expertise, though overlap with the sibling plugins adds some risk of consolidation.
It is another portal-specific tracking plugin within existing competence, kept because maintenance is cheap, although portal changes could prompt pruning.
Net price reporting complements the net price display plugin and draws on the same knowledge base, which supports continued development.
